statement: The community notes specify the independent high- and low-band fields of the conventional four-byte absolute motor word. Reading it as a little-endian integer, bits 2–8 are the high-frequency index (center 320 Hz at index 64), bits 9–15 the high-band amplitude index, bits 16–22 the low-frequency index (center 160 Hz at index 64), and bits 23–29 the low-band amplitude index. The documented neutral word is 00 01 40 40 (both amplitudes zero). Frequency steps are powers of two at 32 steps per octave.

applicability.scope: Community conventional packing and neutral, not compressed forms. Table frequency indices 1 through 127 are documented; amplitude table values are not force, displacement or acceleration measurements. Unsafe encoded extremes must not be interpreted as recommended drive values.
